_comment: Phase 17 checks of the 15 V Board P draft PCB (unvalidated draft, no layout review). DRC: native KiCad 10.0.6 kicad-cli pcb drc --severity-all --refill-zones --schematic-parity, run as heavy-guard -> flock /tmp/kicad-native.lock, with board-p15.kicad_sch beside the draft in a scratch tree. The as-built row is the phase 15 run of the unchanged as-built board. ERC: kicad-cli sch erc on board-p15.kicad_sch. RESET scans: scripts/pcb/board-p-reset-clearance.py (same layer, and in-plane to the other copper layer with --cross-layer); the HV set includes VDD_LOC and VDD_MID. Net parity: scripts/pcb/board-p15/pcb-net-parity.py against board_p15_spec.py (net-parity.json).

drc.new_warnings: Phase 17 adds R22/R23 (SCL/SDA pull-downs), R29/R30 and D9 (VDD feed and clamp). Their copied R0603 silk was moved to F.Fab. Remaining silk warnings: the J2 SCL/SDA labels clip the R22/R23 pads, the J3 VBUS label clips R29 pad 1, the U1 reference clips R21, and the library SOD-123 silk of D9 crosses its own pads. No error class. Silk is OPEN.
drc.schematic_parity_note: extra_footprint only: MH1, MH2 and MH3, the mounting holes with no schematic symbol, which the exporter rule allows.

erc.note: all from the STUSB4500 symbol unspecified pin types

target: RESET copper at least 1.0 mm from VBUS_IN, VBUS_VS_DISCH, DISCH, VBEN, VBUS_OUT and Q1_G copper on its layer (the LED proposed 1.0 mm RESET strap keep-out; no manufacturer source)
as_built_reference: same-layer 0.222 mm (R13 pads) and 0.325 mm (VBUS_VS_DISCH via); other-layer 0.0 mm (B.Cu VBUS_OUT and VBUS_VS_DISCH tracks under the RESET track)
